result.edit: Replaced the sum assignment `assign s=(a&b^ci);` with the correct full-adder XOR expression `assign s=(a^b^ci);`. The original used a bitwise AND of a and b before XORing with ci, which produced wrong sum values (e.g., cycle2 got 00 instead of 01, cycle3 got 11 instead of 10). The carry logic was left unchanged.
